gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Heavy, wide-tracked and loud, Dogica sets lowercase nearly at capital height. Noto Sans Ethiopic handles the quieter job, with sturdy tall lowercase and c terminals hanging far from the bowl.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Dogica stamps out heavy, widely tracked lowercase that rises almost to capital height, with every curve left clearly open. Noto Sans Gothic brings the pair its big, bead-round counters.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Heavy and commanding, Dogica stretches its wide-tracked lowercase up near capital height. Noto Sans Gujarati softens the effect with curved strokes that stop short and large, open counters in its tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-g: Loud, wide and unmistakably chunky, Dogica leans on lowercase that nearly matches its capitals. But Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi keeps text moving, its tall strokes and cut-back terminals leaving generous gaps.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Chunky and wide, Dogica barely tells its lowercase from its capitals. Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line the same way, but its open-channelled e lets the text breathe beneath the heading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Big, blunt and widely spaced, Dogica hits hard with near-capital lowercase. Noto Sans Kannada lets the page cool down, with a gentle bump from small letters to capitals and s curves open at both ends.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Light passes straight through Noto Sans Khojki, whose exits run wide and whose every e shows a large eye. Dogica adds the heavy, commanding punch, with generous wide tracking.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-meetei-ma: Dogica goes big: heavy, widely tracked, with lowercase nearly capital-tall. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek works the other way, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle around large lowercase eyes.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro makes words look dense and tall through the middle, with wide entrances into each letter. Noto Sans Mro is the quieter half against Dogica's heavy, wide-tracked swagger.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-multani: Heavy and wide-spaced, Dogica pushes its lowercase right up toward capital height. Noto Sans Multani counters with an e whose terminal gaps wide and a lofty x-height of its own.
